measures.name: Δ Metragem vs mês ant.
measures.expression: VAR d = CALCULATE(MAX('ficha_producao'[DataProducao])) VAR ini = DATE(YEAR(d), MONTH(d), 1) VAR a = CALCULATE([Metragem Produzida], REMOVEFILTERS(dCalendario), DATESBETWEEN(dCalendario[Date], ini, d)) VAR b = CALCULATE([Metragem Produzida], REMOVEFILTERS(dCalendario), DATESBETWEEN(dCalendario[Date], EDATE(ini, -1), EDATE(d, -1))) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(d) && NOT ISBLANK(a) && NOT ISBLANK(b) && b <> 0, DIVIDE(a - b, b))

measures.name: Δ Disponibilidade vs mês ant.
measures.expression: VAR d = CALCULATE(MAX('Hora-Hora'[Data])) VAR ini = DATE(YEAR(d), MONTH(d), 1) VAR a = CALCULATE([Disponibilidade %], REMOVEFILTERS(dCalendario), DATESBETWEEN(dCalendario[Date], ini, d)) VAR b = CALCULATE([Disponibilidade %], REMOVEFILTERS(dCalendario), DATESBETWEEN(dCalendario[Date], EDATE(ini, -1), EDATE(d, -1))) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(d) && NOT ISBLANK(a) && NOT ISBLANK(b), a - b)

measures.name: Δ Tempo Parado vs mês ant.
measures.expression: VAR d = CALCULATE(MAX('Hora-Hora'[Data])) VAR ini = DATE(YEAR(d), MONTH(d), 1) VAR a = CALCULATE([% Tempo Parado], REMOVEFILTERS(dCalendario), DATESBETWEEN(dCalendario[Date], ini, d)) VAR b = CALCULATE([% Tempo Parado], REMOVEFILTERS(dCalendario), DATESBETWEEN(dCalendario[Date], EDATE(ini, -1), EDATE(d, -1))) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(d) && NOT ISBLANK(a) && NOT ISBLANK(b), a - b)

measures.name: Δ Refugo PPM vs mês ant.
measures.expression: VAR d = CALCULATE(MAX('ficha_producao'[DataProducao])) VAR ini = DATE(YEAR(d), MONTH(d), 1) VAR a = CALCULATE([Refugo PPM], REMOVEFILTERS(dCalendario), DATESBETWEEN(dCalendario[Date], ini, d)) VAR b = CALCULATE([Refugo PPM], REMOVEFILTERS(dCalendario), DATESBETWEEN(dCalendario[Date], EDATE(ini, -1), EDATE(d, -1))) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(d) && NOT ISBLANK(a) && NOT ISBLANK(b), a - b)

measures.name: HH Principal Parada
measures.expression: VAR t = ADDCOLUMNS(FILTER(VALUES(fHoraHora[Motivo Padrão]), NOT ISBLANK(fHoraHora[Motivo Padrão])), "MinParado", CALCULATE(SUM(fHoraHora[Tempo Parado (min)]))) VAR topo = TOPN(1, FILTER(t, [MinParado] > 0), [MinParado], DESC) RETURN IF(COUNTROWS(topo) = 0, "Sem parada", MAXX(topo, fHoraHora[Motivo Padrão]))
